previous_last_sync.summary: Human-reviewed manual recovery audit for atomic scheduler callback batches. Source evidence is pinned at [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md); no new user setting or workflow requires a guide. The ledger limits the integration merge to the audited original.

decisions.rationale: Reserves all records before publishing a callback batch so a full or invalid request cannot partially schedule pulses; it is internal queue behavior.
evidence: [firmware/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/CHANGELOG.md): Scheduler batches atomically reserve paired output transitions and avoid partially scheduled pulses.

[firmware/controllers/system/timer/event_queue.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/system/timer/event_queue.cpp): Batch admission validates bounds, reserves records and rolls back failed reservations.

[firmware/controllers/system/timer/scheduler.cpp](https://github.com/capoworks/capoworks-ecu/blob/825d7fda5c32b7ec3f755be4897775819e8605d1/firmware/controllers/system/timer/scheduler.cpp): Hardware, simulator and test executors share atomic batch admission.
